rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / TRUST FUNDS / FISCAL YEAR 2012 SUMMARY REPORT`, PDF page 73 of the FY2012 annual town report (4118-fy-2012-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folio 70, marked `Page 1 of 2`; page 74 is Page 2 of 2. EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on all 116 pages, tested per page -- so it was read off the page's OWN stored bitmap, not a re-render; NO recognition was used. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4), is `FUND NAME` | `BEGINNING BALANCE PRINCIPAL` | `BEGINNNING BALANCE EARNINGS` | `CONTRIB TO PRINCIPAL` | `NET EARNINGS` | `DISBURSE FROM PRINCIPAL` | `TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS` | `ENDING CASH VALUE` | `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` | `ENDING MARKET VALUE` -- the second one is printed with three Ns, `BEGINNNING`, and is transcribed here as the page spells it. Nine money columns, the same nine FY2015 prints, and the same two identities. WHAT PROVES IT: every fund row closes on BOTH identities, and the group's own printed SUBTOTAL closes in ALL NINE columns, exactly, no tolerance declared. ONE FIGURE WAS CORRECTED BY RE-READING, not by arithmetic: PERPETUAL CARE BEQUEST's BEGINNNING BALANCE EARNINGS reads $7,864.33. A first pass off a 0.42-scale render of the whole page read $7,884.33, which misses the row's own ending cash value by exactly $20.00 and the cemetery SUBTOTAL by the same $20.00. The figure was then re-read off a full-scale crop of that band and is $7,864.33 on the page -- the arithmetic said WHERE to look, the page said WHAT it says (rule 14). WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: nothing here reconciles these funds to the Treasurer's cash or to the general ledger; it is what this one statement prints about itself. GROUP: CEMETERY FUNDS.
